# tokens.py
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Optional

@dataclass
class Token:
    type:   str
    value:  Any
    line:   int
    col:    int

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Token({self.type}, {self.value!r}, {self.line}:{self.col})"

# Token types
TK_NUMBER  = "NUMBER"
TK_BOOL    = "BOOL"
TK_IDENT   = "IDENT"
TK_PLUS    = "+"
TK_MINUS   = "-"
TK_STAR    = "*"
TK_SLASH   = "/"
TK_LPAREN  = "("
TK_RPAREN  = ")"
TK_EQ      = "=="
TK_NEQ     = "!="
TK_LT      = "<"
TK_GT      = ">"
TK_LEQ     = "<="
TK_GEQ     = ">="
TK_ASSIGN  = "="
TK_ARROW   = "->"
TK_LET     = "let"
TK_LETREC  = "letrec"
TK_IN      = "in"
TK_IF      = "if"
TK_THEN    = "then"
TK_ELSE    = "else"
TK_FUN     = "fun"
TK_EOF     = "EOF"

KEYWORDS = {"let": TK_LET, "letrec": TK_LETREC, "in": TK_IN,
            "if": TK_IF, "then": TK_THEN, "else": TK_ELSE,
            "fun": TK_FUN, "true": TK_BOOL, "false": TK_BOOL}

print("Token types defined.")
